people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: They spoke to Moses, saying, “The people have brought much more than enough for the service of the work which Yahweh commanded to make.”
translations.bsb: and said to Moses, “The people are bringing more than enough for doing the work the LORD has commanded us to do.”
translations.kjv: And they spake unto Moses, saying, The people bring much more than enough for the service of the work, which the LORD commanded to make.
translations.asv: And they spake unto Moses, saying, The people bring much more than enough for the service of the work which Jehovah commanded to make.
